For gewerbliche Einzelunternehmen and Personengesellschaften. Capital companies (GmbH/AG) file a separate KSt 1 instead. Have your tax advisor review before filing.

anlageG.hebesatzHint: Adjust to your municipality — e.g. 470 % in Köln, 490 % in München. Company.settings.hebesatz
anlageG.hinzuHint: Only Kz 4100 (25% rent/lease) is auto-derived from bookings. Other add-backs (interest on shareholder loans, loss allocations, silent deposits) need to be added by the tax advisor from the Gewerbesteuergesetz and the contracts.
anlageG.kurzungHint: Only Kz 5100 (50% private-use share of vehicle expenses) is auto-derived. Other deductions (1.2% Grundstückserträge from the unit value, partnership profit allocations) need to be added from the contracts.

anlageN.title: Anlage N (preview)
anlageN.subtitle: Income from employment (§ 3 EStG) — from your Lohnsteuerbescheinigung + manually-entered Werbungskosten / Sonderausgaben / Außergewöhnliche Belastungen. For employees, civil servants, managing directors with employment contracts, part-time workers. The Lohnsteuerbescheinigung is issued by your employer (one A4 page per year) — please enter the values below. Have your tax advisor review before filing.
anlageN.lsbMissing: ⚠ No Lohnsteuerbescheinigung recorded for this year. Please enter the values from your wage tax certificate below.
anlageN.lohnsteuerHint: These amounts have already been remitted to the Finanzamt by the employer and will be credited against the assessed income tax (§ 36 Abs. 2 EStG).
anlageN.fieldHint: Copy the values from your Lohnsteuerbescheinigung. Enter to-the-cent — the Finanzamt rounds to full euros.
anlageN.wkhint: 130 = Arbeitnehmer-Pauschbetrag (auto, 1.230 EUR). The other Kz (140-190) are manual — work days × km × 0.30 EUR for Entfernungspauschale etc.
anlageN.sahint: Vorsorgeaufwand above the basic cap (Rürup / Riester). The KV/PV portions are already deducted from the gross.
anlageN.abhint: Medical costs, disability (Pauschbetrag per GdB), funeral costs, care — deductible from 1% gross (reasonable burden).

kst1.title: KSt 1 (preview)
kst1.subtitle: Corporate tax return (§ 1 Abs. 1 KStG) — the PRIMARY tax form for capital companies (GmbH, AG, KGaA). Anlage G is NOT applicable — KSt 1 replaces it. Reads the G+V Jahresüberschuss + computes KSt 15% + Soli 5.5% + GewSt (no 100k allowance for GmbH, default Hebesatz 400%) + KSt-Anrechnung auf GewSt (§ 35 EStG / § 26 KStG). KSt corrections (hidden profit distributions, donations, loss carryforward) are placeholder — the tax advisor adds them. Have your tax advisor review before filing.
kst1.kapitalgesellschaftHinweis: ✓ Corporation — KSt 1 is the applicable return.
kst1.keinKStHinweis: ⚠ This company is not a capital company. KSt 1 only applies to corporations (GmbH, AG, KGaA, UG). For sole proprietors / partnerships with trade income: Anlage G + Einkommensteuererklärung.
kst1.kstAnrechnung: KSt credit against GewSt (§ 35 EStG / § 26 KStG)
kst1.kstHint: KSt prepayments (Kz 60) are NOT subtracted here — the tax advisor offsets the prepayments in the assessment.
kst1.korrekturenHint: These corrections (hidden profit distributions, donations, loss carryforward, § 8b KStG) are placeholder — the tax advisor adds them from contracts, donation receipts, and loss carryforward notices. v2: editable under Company.settings.kst1Korrekturen[year].

anlageR.title: Anlage R (preview)
anlageR.subtitle: Income from pensions (§ 22 EStG) — from your Rentenbezüge (DRV, BAV, Riester, Rürup, private Rente, Sonstige) + automatically computed Besteuerungsanteil (BMF table, 2026: 81%) + Werbungskosten-Pauschbetrag 102 EUR. For retirees, pensioners, and recipients of Witwen-/Waisenrente. Enter the gross Rentenbezüge from your Rentenbescheide below. Have your tax advisor review before filing.
anlageR.rentenMissing: ⚠ No Rentenbezüge recorded for this year. Please enter the gross Rentenbezüge from your pension notices below.
anlageR.fieldHint: Enter the gross Rentenbezüge (before Besteuerungsanteil) from your pension notices. Enter to-the-cent.

anlageKind.title: Anlage Kind (preview)
anlageKind.subtitle: Kinderfreibetrag + Kindergeld (§ 32 / § 33 / § 33a EStG) — for families with children. Kindergeld 250 EUR / child (1-3), max 1,000 EUR for 4+ children (as of 2024). Kinderfreibetrag 7,932 EUR / child (6,612 EUR subsistence minimum + 1,320 EUR care/education needs). The tax office applies the MORE FAVORABLE of (Kindergeld) vs (Kinderfreibetrag × tax rate) — your tax advisor verifies. Enter your children from the Kindergeldbescheid / Lohnsteuerbescheinigung below. Have your tax advisor review before filing.
anlageKind.kinderMissing: ⚠ No children recorded for this year. Please enter the children from your Kindergeldbescheid below.
anlageKind.fieldHint: Enter the children from the Kindergeldbescheid / Lohnsteuerbescheinigung. Date of birth in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
anlageKind.betragHint: Kindergeld 250 EUR / child (1-3), max 1,000 EUR for 4+ children. Kinderfreibetrag 7,932 EUR / child (6,612 EUR subsistence minimum + 1,320 EUR care/education needs).

bilanz.title: Balance Sheet (preview)
bilanz.subtitle: Assets and liabilities snapshot as of Dec 31 — auto-derived from your open receivables, cash balance, and customer credits. Positions without source data are marked "nicht ausgewiesen" (not stated). The equity line is a placeholder. Have your tax advisor complete it before filing.
bilanz.previewHint: PREVIEW — only partially derived from the bookkeeping data in the system. The remaining positions (fixed assets, equity movements, provisions, accruals) must be completed by the tax advisor from the SKR03 / commercial register. The equity line is a placeholder.

guv.title: Income Statement (preview)
guv.subtitle: G+V per § 275 (2) HGB (total cost method) — auto-derived from your revenue, expenses, and customer credits. Positions without source data are marked "nicht ausgewiesen" (not stated). Your tax advisor completes the missing positions from the fixed asset register, tax assessments, and the BWA.
guv.previewHint: PREVIEW — only partially derived from the bookkeeping data in the system. The remaining positions (depreciation, inventory changes, investment income, interest income, income taxes) must be completed by the tax advisor. Have your tax advisor verify before filing.

assets.title: Asset Register
assets.subtitle: Fixed assets with linear depreciation — acquisition costs, useful life, and net book value. Auto-fills § 266 HGB Bilanz positions 0100-0500 (A. Fixed assets) and § 275 HGB G+V position 7a (Depreciation).
assets.noAssets: No assets yet — add fixed assets so the Bilanz + G+V can auto-fill the depreciation positions.
assets.disposeHint: Enter sale date and price. The asset is removed from the balance sheet pool.
assets.deleteHint: A disposed asset can no longer be edited. Disposing documents the sale; for deletion, contact your tax advisor.
assets.bookAfaConfirmHint: Automatically creates one expense booking per asset for the year {year}. Affects P&L 7a, BWA 3100 and Anlage S 4600.
assets.bookAfaConfirmFootnote: Note: booking is idempotent — clicking again will not create duplicate entries. Already disposed assets are skipped.
assets.afaBookedHint: AfA for this year has been booked (shows up in P&L 7a, BWA 3100, Anlage S 4600).
assets.afaNotBookedHint: AfA has not been booked yet — the value appears only as a computed estimate in the reports. Click "Book AfA" above to create a real expense booking.
assets.bookAfaMonthlyOk: {count} AfA bookings created (12 months × assets), total: {total}
assets.bookAfaMonthlyConfirmHint: Automatically creates 12 monthly expense bookings per asset for {year} (instead of 1 year-end booking). BWA 3100 then shows the booked AfA in each month instead of just December.
assets.bookAfaMonthlyConfirmFootnote: Note: monthly and annual booking modes are mutually exclusive — you cannot switch modes after the first booking. To change, storno first.
assets.stornoAfaConfirmHint: Deletes all {count} booked AfA expenses for {year} (total: {total}). The action is logged in the audit trail.
assets.stornoAfaConfirmFootnote: Note: After storno, the booking can be re-done in annual OR monthly mode. The audit log entries remain permanently.

anhang.title: Notes to the Financial Statements
anhang.subtitle: PREVIEW per § 284 HGB — auto-generated from Bilanz + G+V + Asset register. Mandatory disclosures (§ 285 HGB) are marked and must be completed before filing.
anhang.sectionIII: III. Notes to the Balance Sheet
anhang.sectionIV: IV. Notes to the Income Statement
anhang.beraterHint: To be completed by the tax advisor
anhang.previewHint: PREVIEW — auto-generated from the data in the system. Sections marked 'To be completed by the tax advisor' (§ 285 HGB mandatory disclosures) must be filled in before filing. Have your tax advisor verify before filing.

packager.title: Tax advisor package
packager.subtitle: Bundles every VORSCHAU report (EÜR, Anlage S, Balance Sheet, P&L, Notes, Asset Register + MANIFEST.md) into a single ZIP for handover to your tax advisor.
packager.contentEuer: Anlage EÜR (Income statement for small business) — preview
packager.contentAnhang: Notes to the financial statements (§ 284 HGB) — preview
packager.contentAssetCsv: Asset register (CSV) — fixed assets with depreciation
packager.previewHint: PREVIEW — the tax advisor package is an honest preview, not a finalized annual report. The 'not stated' positions must be completed by your tax advisor before filing. Have your tax advisor verify before handover.

bwa.title: BWA (Operating analysis)
bwa.subtitle: DATEV-standard BWA with monthly / previous month / YTD / prior-year-YTD / Δ %. Sources: invoices, expenses, and asset depreciation.
bwa.label: Description
bwa.previewHint: PREVIEW — based on the data in de-invoice v1. Positions the system does not track (inventory changes, capitalised own services, interest income, investment income, taxes) are not stated. Your tax advisor completes the missing positions from the SKR03 / BWA source data.
bwa.qtitle: BWA quarterly comparison (Q vs prior-year Q)
bwa.qsubtitle: Berater default view: current quarter vs the same quarter last year. The YTD at quarter end (Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec) equals the Q total.

ebilanz.title: E-Bilanz VORSCHAU (XBRL)
ebilanz.subtitle: Automatically generates a BMF eBilanz-in-xtml VORSCHAU for the selected year. Berater fills the placeholder positions before ELSTER upload.
ebilanz.vorschau: VORSCHAU: BMF Taxonomy 6.7 — to be validated by the Berater in the ELSTER client.
ebilanz.positionCount: {computed} of {total} mandatory positions computed. Remaining positions are placeholders for the Berater.

featureFlags.title: Feature flags
featureFlags.subtitle: Per-company switches for auto-booking and Berater packager. Changes are logged in the audit trail.

autoBookAfa.label: Auto-book AfA
autoBookAfa.description: The auto-AfA scheduler books the previous month's AfA for every asset of this company on the 1st of each month. Disable if you want to book AfA manually.

anlageV.label: Include Anlage V in Berater packager
anlageV.description: Force-include Anlage V (rental & leasing income, § 21 EStG) in the year-end Berater packager ZIP. By default, only included when the company has building assets in the Anlagenverzeichnis.

anlageG.label: Include Anlage G in Berater packager
anlageG.description: Force-include Anlage G (trade / commercial income, § 15 EStG) in the year-end Berater packager ZIP. By default, only included when the company had commercial revenue (invoices) in the year. Capital companies (GmbH/AG) file a separate KSt 1 instead.

anlageN.label: Include Anlage N in Berater packager
anlageN.description: Force-include Anlage N (employment income, § 3 EStG) in the year-end Berater packager ZIP. By default, only included when a Lohnsteuerbescheinigung is recorded in Company.settings.lohnsteuerbescheinigungen for the year. For employees, civil servants, managing directors with employment contracts.

anlageKind.label: Include Anlage Kind in Berater packager
anlageKind.description: Force-include Anlage Kind (Kinderfreibetrag + Kindergeld, § 32 / § 33 / § 33a EStG) in the year-end Berater packager ZIP. By default, only included when children are recorded in Company.settings.kinder for the year. For families with children claiming Kindergeld or Kinderfreibetrag.

anlageSo.label: Include Anlage SO in Berater package
anlageSo.description: Force-include the Anlage SO (Other income, § 22 EStG) in the year-end Berater package ZIP. By default only included if private Veräußerungsgeschäfte or wiederkehrende Bezüge were entered for the fiscal year in Company.settings.anlageSO. For private sales (crypto, gold, stocks) and recurring income (private pensions, maintenance).
anlageSo.effectLabel: Affects: Anlage-SO.pdf in the Berater package

anlageAus.label: Include Anlage AUS in Berater package
anlageAus.description: Force-include the Anlage AUS (Foreign income, § 34d EStG) in the year-end Berater package ZIP. By default only included if foreign income entries were entered for the fiscal year in Company.settings.anlageAUS. For Mandanten with foreign business, foreign dividends/interest/rental, or DBA-exempt income.
anlageAus.effectLabel: Affects: Anlage-AUS.pdf in the Berater package

ustja.title: Annual VAT Return (UStJA)
ustja.subtitle: Aggregates the 12 monthly UStVAs (Jan–Dec) into an annual VAT return (§ 18 para. 3 UStG, BMF form 2024). The tax assessment sets the actual VAT liability; monthly UStVAs are prepayments. Tax advisor transfers the numbers manually to ELSTER or their StB software (v1: no native ELSTER XML export).
ustja.fieldsHint: Tax bases (Kz 20-23) and input VAT (Kz 67) are derived from the 12 monthly UStVAs. Sondervorauszahlung (Kz 39) is 1/11 of the January UStVA per § 47 para. 1 UStDV. Restzahlung (Kz 69) is due to the Finanzamt by July 31 of the following year.
ustja.restzahlungHint: Restzahlung (Kz 69) — due to the Finanzamt by 31.07 of the following year
ustja.elsterXmlHint: Native BMF Datenlieferung packet for ELSTER upload. Since 2024, UStJA is mandatory via ELSTER.
ustja.asciiPreviewHint: Plain-text preview for sanity checking before upload (same format as Mein-ELSTER paste-import).

gewst.title: Trade tax return (GewSt)
gewst.subtitle: Standalone trade tax return per BMF form GewSt 1A 2024. Reads Gewerbeertrag + Hebesatz + Freibetrag from Anlage G (§ 15 EStG). Tax advisor enters the prepayments from the 4 quarterly assessments below. v1: no native ELSTER XML export — tax advisor transfers the numbers manually to ELSTER or their StB software.
gewst.vorauszahlungenHint: From the 4 quarterly assessments (15.02/15.05/15.08/15.11). Tax advisor enters the actually paid amounts — the assessed GewSt minus prepayments = difference (Kz 12, positive = residual payment).
gewst.fieldsHint: Kz 5 (Steuermessbetrag) = Gewerbeertrag after Freibetrag × 0.035. Kz 7 (Hebesatz) = municipal Hebesatz (default 400; Köln 470, München 490, Münster 400, Stuttgart 420). Kz 10 (assessed GewSt) = Kz 5 × Kz 7 / 100. Kz 11 (prepayments) = Q1-Q4 sum. Kz 12 (difference) = Kz 10 - Kz 11.

payments.title: SEPA batch payment (pain.001)
payments.subtitle: Bundles open payables (Eingangsrechnungen) with valid supplier IBAN into a single pain.001.001.09 XML file. The Berater downloads the XML and uploads it in the house bank's online banking portal (e.g. Sparkasse, Volksbank, DKB, Commerzbank). The bank executes the transfers 1-2 banking days after the execution date. The bank-statement import then reconciles the actual bookings against the planned batch (auto-reco).
payments.empty: No open payables with a valid supplier IBAN. Add IBANs under Suppliers → Bank details, or book more Eingangsrechnungen.
payments.batchCreated: SEPA batch created — XML download available below.
payments.cardDesc: pain.001 batch export for open payables (supplier IBAN required).
payments.requireSelection: Please select at least one expense.

payments.executionDateFuture: Execution date must be in the future.

openInvoicesCard.title: Open invoices for direct debit
openInvoicesCard.subtitle: Select the invoices to collect via direct debit. Only invoices with an active mandate are listed.
openInvoicesCard.emptyState: No open invoices with a mandate. Create a mandate first.
openInvoicesCard.executionDateHelp: Date the bank will collect the direct debit (due date + at least 5 banking days).

toast.invalidIban: IBAN must start with 2 uppercase letters + 2 digits (e.g. DE89…)

anlageSo.title: Anlage SO (Other Income)
anlageSo.subtitle: Other income (§ 22 EStG) — private Veräußerungsgeschäfte (crypto / gold / stocks within the Spekulationsfrist) + wiederkehrende Bezüge (private pensions, maintenance). €600/year Freigrenze for Veräußerungsgewinne (§ 23 Abs. 3 sentence 5 EStG).
anlageSo.transactionsHint: Each sale within the Spekulationsfrist (1 year for securities / 10 years for other assets) is income-tax-liable. Sales outside the Frist are tax-free.
anlageSo.wiederkehrendeHint: Private pensions, Versorgungsleistungen, maintenance payments. Werbungskosten-Pauschbetrag €102 (statutory pensions).
anlageSo.emptyTransactions: No private Veräußerungsgeschäfte entered. Click 'Add transaction' to add a transaction.
anlageSo.emptyWiederkehrende: No wiederkehrende Bezüge entered. Add private pensions / maintenance payments below.
anlageSo.loadError: Failed to load Anlage SO data

v2.csvImportHint: CSV with columns: type (optional), description, acquisitionDate, acquisitionCost, saleDate, salePrice. Date format dd.mm.yyyy, decimal separator comma. Example: BTC,0.1 BTC,15.06.2024,5000,00,20.03.2025,8000,00
v2.expenseImportHint: Bank transactions with Expense.category = 'crypto' or 'brokerage' are automatically converted into private Veräußerungsgeschäfte. Already-imported expenses are skipped (idempotent).
v2.lossCarryforwardTitle: Loss offset & loss carryforward (§ 23 Abs. 3 EStG)

anlageAus.title: Anlage AUS (Foreign Income)
anlageAus.subtitle: Foreign income (§ 34d EStG) — for income sourced outside Germany that is taxable in Germany. DBA-exempt income gets Progressionsvorbehalt (§ 32b EStG); without DBA, foreign tax is credited. For KapG (GmbH/AG/KGaA/UG): § 8b KStG — 95% of foreign dividends tax-free, 5% non-deductible.
anlageAus.entriesHint: One row per country. For multiple income types in the same country, add multiple rows.
anlageAus.emptyEntries: No foreign income entered. Click 'Add entry' to add a row per country.

datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.heading: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.intro: This privacy policy informs you in accordance with Art. 13 GDPR about the processing of personal data when visiting and using our web application.
datenschutz.controllerText: The controller responsible for data processing on this web application is the provider named in the Legal Notice.
datenschutz.dataTypesText: When visiting this web application, the following data is automatically processed:
datenschutz.dataTypesList: IP address (anonymised), date and time of access, URL accessed, data volume transferred, HTTP status code, user agent. For registered users: email address, name, invoice data, payment data as entered by you.
datenschutz.purposeText: Processing is carried out to provide the web application (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR — performance of contract), to fulfil legal retention obligations (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. c GDPR — legal obligation, in particular § 147 AO for accounting records) and to ensure operational security (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR — legitimate interest).
datenschutz.retentionText: Invoices, accounting records and business correspondence are retained for ten years in accordance with § 147 AO. Other usage data will be deleted after 30 days, provided no legal retention obligations prevent this.
datenschutz.rightsText: You have the right to information (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and objection to processing (Art. 21). You may withdraw any consent given at any time with effect for the future (Art. 7 para. 3 GDPR). Please direct complaints to the competent data protection supervisory authority.
datenschutz.transferText: Your data is not transferred to third countries. Where third-party providers (e.g. hosting, payment service providers) are used, this is only done on the basis of the EU Commission's standard contractual clauses.
datenschutz.hostingText: This application is operated on servers within the European Union. The specific location and the data centre service provider are documented within the framework of technical and organisational measures (TOM).
datenschutz.cookiesText: This application uses technically necessary cookies and — only with your explicit consent — analytics and marketing cookies. You can withdraw or adjust your consent at any time via the cookie settings at the bottom of the page.
datenschutz.changesText: We reserve the right to adapt this privacy policy so that it always complies with current legal requirements. The new privacy policy will then apply to your next visit.

cookieBanner.title: Cookie Settings
cookieBanner.intro: We use cookies and similar technologies to ensure the operation of this web application and — with your consent — to analyse usage. You can decide which categories you wish to allow.

necessary.label: Necessary
necessary.description: These cookies are technically required for the operation of the application (authentication, security, load balancing). They cannot be disabled.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: Help us understand how visitors use the application so we can improve the user experience. Only with your consent.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.description: Used to display relevant content and ads to visitors. Only with your consent.
